sloka: गंगा हिमवतो ज्येष्ठा दुहिता पुरुषर्षभ ।तस्याम् कुरु महाबाहो पितॄणाम् तु जल क्रियाम् ॥१-४१-१९॥
transliteration: gaṁgā himavato jyeṣṭhā duhitā puruṣarṣabha ।tasyām kuru mahābāho pitṝṇām tu jala kriyām ॥1-41-19॥

translations.english: 'O Best among men O Mightyarmed one perform the traditional rites of your uncles with water from river Ganga, the eldest daughter of Himavat'.
